description: This file defines the AcknowledgementFactory class, a final utility class providing static methods for creating and combining Acknowledgement and Acknowledgements instances within the Eclipse Ditto project. It acts as a factory for generating acknowledgements related to entity updates, enabling creation of individual acknowledgements, collections of acknowledgements, and empty acknowledgement objects, primarily used for handling asynchronous acknowledgment messages.

classes.name: AcknowledgementFactory
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for creating acknowledgements and acknowledgment collections.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgement instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Combines multiple acknowledgements into an Acknowledgements collection, ensuring all have matching entity IDs and types.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates an Acknowledgements collection for a specific entity ID, based on existing acknowledgements and a status code.

methods.name: emptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Returns an empty Acknowledgements instance for a given entity ID and headers.
